summary: Phase 9: In-app chat (polling) and Delivery OTP verification — All 16 backend tests passed (100%) and all 10 frontend flows verified. No bugs found. Full feature is working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: admin/orders.tsx line 376: e?.data?.detail — depends on how api.patch surfaces error detail from FastAPI. If api client wraps the response body in e.data, this works. Verified working in actual test (OTP Error alert shows correct message).
admin/orders.tsx kpiRow: no flexDirection:row defined, so KPI tiles stack vertically (1 column). This is intentional current design and works correctly.
orders.py line 253: _is_chat_authorized allows role 'store_manager' — consistent with admin access pattern, correct.
chat.tsx polls every 5 seconds via setInterval — no race condition risk since fetchMessages is wrapped in useCallback with stable deps. Correct implementation.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test orders (TEST_Frontend Chat ord_8ce699a868b8=accepted, TEST_Frontend OTP ord_bdd1829da45d=out_for_delivery→delivered). ord_bdd1829da45d was delivered via the OTP modal test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 9 fully verified. Chat endpoints work (GET/POST /api/orders/{id}/chat), auth (403 for non-owners), blocked for delivered/cancelled orders. OTP auto-generated on out_for_delivery transition, validated on delivered transition (no OTP→400, wrong→400, correct→200). Customer sees OTP card prominently; admin has 💬 chat button on all cards and Mark Delivered triggers OTP modal. Chat screen loads with empty state, messages send and render correctly with polling.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found in this iteration.
